notes.title: 2024/10/17. Game version update instructions
notes.notes:
Rule adjustment:

1. In single-player games, the game timer will be paused after entering the store or challenge area until the player returns to the level.
(Multiplayer games are not affected by this rule)

2. A boss-level monster [Thunder] has been added to the challenge chamber [Easy to Hide], and defeating it will directly complete this challenge.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Other improvements:

1. Icons are configured for all weapon modules of the three protagonists.

2. Icons are configured for all talent skills (sprint/rage/flash) of the three protagonists.

3. Full support for XBOX and PS5 controller operations.

4. The setting interface has added detailed adjustment parameters for the joystick of the controller, and the option layout has been optimized.

5. An exclusive icon is configured for purchasing drones from the enhanced merchant.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

New content:

1. Weapons and blue props purchased with money have been added to the store for sale

2. All challenge chambers have exclusive boss drop rewards.

3. Added 5 passive items

[Redistributor]: Restore 5 points of armor when defeating an enemy (increases 5 points per level).

[Paralysis Toxin]: When shooting an enemy, reduce its attack power by 3 points (increases 3 points per level) for 2 seconds.

[Healing Device]: Every 30 seconds, create a healing light ball at the player's current position (increases one per level), restore 10% health per second for friendly units within 15 meters, and last for 10 seconds.

[Reinforcement Device]: Every 30 seconds, create a reinforcement light ball at the player's current position (increases one per level), increase 15% damage per second for friendly units within 15 meters, and last for 10 seconds.

[Explosive Device]: Every 30 seconds, create a blasting light ball at the player's current position (increases one per level), causing 300% damage per second to enemies within 15 meters, and lasts for 10 seconds.

notes.title: 2024/09/23. Game version update instructions
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

1. [Live Broadcast Mode] will no longer be able to be switched on and off in the intra-office [Settings] interface.

2. Fixed an issue that may cause the game to crash when launching "Return of the Jedi" when updating content from any game creative workshop in the steam game library.

-------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ----------

Balance adjustments:

1. Adjust the skills and combat rhythm of the elite monster [Ape].

2. Adjust the skills and combat rhythm of the elite monster [Iron Fist].

3. Adjust the skills and combat rhythm of the elite monster [Fattos].

4. Adjust the skills and combat rhythm of the elite monster [Dream Capture].

-------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ----------

Other improvements:

1. Changed the icons of all active props.

2. Optimize and adjust the three protagonist models.

-------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ----------

New content:
1. Preliminary completion of support for handle functions

notes.title: 2024/09/06.Game version update notes
notes.notes:
Balance adjustment:
1. Adjust the bullet screen effect and battle rhythm of Boss [Lone Star].
2. Appropriately weakened the damage of Boss [Punishment] tracking bullet.

Other improvements:
1. Added icons to some [Weapon Modules].
(Gu Hong [Penetration] [Shock], Li Jingcai [Refraction] [Starburst], Adele [Annihilation] [Judgment])
2. Changed the appearance color of Boss [Lone Star].
3. Map size resource optimization
4. The [Weapon Module] interface can now view the unlocked module functions and prompt the achievements required to unlock the relevant content.
5. The [Character Outfit] interface can now prompt the achievements required to unlock the relevant content.

New content:
1. Added [Live Mode], which will block the more exposed costumes of some protagonists and monsters after turning it on.

notes.title: 2024/8/30.Game version update instructions
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
1. Fixed the problem that the talent skill [Blood Rage] of Adele's set [Trampling] could not correctly cancel the attack enhancement effect after being turned off.

Balance adjustment:
1. Greatly reduced the duration of the player's stiffness caused by knockback, knockdown or knock-up attacks.
2. Slightly adjusted the barrage effect of Boss [Prototype].
3. Slightly adjusted the first-stage battle rhythm of Boss [Count].
4. Canceled the knockback effect of the bullets of the elite monster [Venomous Insect].
5. Adjusted the gun drop, and no more group damage high-power weapons will be dropped in the first round (early). More guns will be dropped when there are multiple bosses.

Other improvements:
1. The [Character Module] interface can now preview the appearance and functions of unlocked skins.
2. The performance of projectile explosives has been replaced for the monster enhancement affix [Counter].
3. The performance of flying objects has been replaced for the monster enhancement affix [Surround].
4. The teleportation of Boss [Count] has a new special effect.
5. The appearance of the bullets of the challenge room boss [Gatling (machine)] has been changed.

New content:
1. Officially added the record of the user's graphics card driver (the first run will trigger pre-compilation).

notes.title: 2024/8/23.Game version update instructions
notes.notes:
Bug fix:
1. Corrected the problem of partial material pre-compilation failure, which may cause users using mechanical hard drives to experience obvious abnormal lag when running the game for the first time.

Balance adjustment:
1. Adjust the difficulty of the final boss [Punishment of Evil] appropriately.

Other improvements:
1. Added a description label to the main interface of the game. When using [TAB] to pause the game, you can view the function description of the relevant UI module by hovering the mouse.

New content:
1. Li Jingcai suit [scarlet].

2. Adele suit [Trample].

notes.title: 2024/8/16.Game version update instructions
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
1. Corrected the counting function errors of some achievements.

Balance adjustments:
1. The effect of the active item [Gravity] can no longer affect the Boss.
2. Li Jingcai's module [Qiqiao] will now cause a total of 1800% fire range damage.
3. Li Jingcai's module [Infiltration] allows the treated unit to restore armor during treatment.

Other improvements:
1. Changed the font of the damage number.
2. Updated and iterated some of the in-game UI.
3. Added a mechanism for automatic reconnection after disconnection to the game.
4. Attacks on [vital] parts have a separate flashing effect.

notes.title: 2024/8/9. Game version update instructions
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
1. Fixed an error where being killed by 'Punish Evil' did not trigger the achievement 'Death Certificate' count properly in some cases.

Balance adjustment:
1. Weaken the defensive and offensive capabilities of some miscellaneous soldiers appropriately.
2. The effect of the active prop 'Heavenly Palace Egg' can now be overlaid.
3. Move the first level Boss [Fortress] to the rear and cancel the combat vulnerability effect of [Captain].
4. The position determination type Boss (Captain/Fortress) can still cause normal damage to the designated area after damaging it.

Other improvements:
1. Adjusted the unlocking conditions for two female protagonists.
2. Adjust the appearance of some supply resources in the level to enhance visibility.
3. The 'Quick Game' function in the 'Multiplayer Game' option of the main menu has been cancelled.
4. After unlocking the option, a default option selection box for bonus items will pop up for the outdated database.

notes.title: 2024/8/6. Game version update instructions
notes.notes:
Bug fix:  
1. Fixed the issue where some vehicles and objects in urban scenes cannot correctly block bullets.
2. Fixed the issue where the achievement 'Shadow First Appears' popped up on Steam due to incorrect conditions.
3. Fixed an issue where the Venom in the Boss battle scene may not move correctly.
4. Fixed an issue where switching windows at low resolution on some old models of monitors may cause game crashes.
5. Fix the issue of Adele's skin not being properly affected by her talent (using violence to counter violence, unleashing anger, and keeping her mind calm).

notes.title: Game update instructions.2024/8/2
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
1. Fix the issue of skin noise not being properly affected by external talents.
2. Fixed the issue where the enhanced interface would play teammate enhanced UI animations when opened.
3. Fixed the issue where the Spiral Storm special effect could not continue to display correctly after being transferred across levels.
4. Fixed the issue where reinforced monsters with self destruct affixes may not be able to inflict damage correctly during explosions.
5. Fixed the issue where bosses did not drop based on the number of players in a multiplayer game (the number of drops should be [number of players * number of bosses]).

Balance adjustment:
1. Upgrade low-level monsters and drop money.
2. Reduced the boss's vulnerability punishment during wartime.
3. Cancelled the melee repelling ability of most of the miscellaneous soldiers.
4. The bullet acceleration of the module 'Shake' cancels rebound, increases explosion range and flies, and explodes upon touch.

Other improvements:
1. The second level of Route 1 is located at the back of the store to improve the purchasing experience.
2. The 'Return Menu' button on the settlement interface has added a second confirmation to avoid accidental touches.
3. Adjust the unlocking condition for Adele to 'Accumulate kills of 6 boss level monsters'.
4. Replace the elite of the first level of Route 2 with 'Resonance' to avoid the feeling of powerlessness caused by monster damage reduction in the early stages of the game.
5. Added relevant special effects to elites with damage reduction mechanisms or target weakening mechanisms, such as "Ash", "Poison Bug/Gambler", "Fatos", and "Dream Stealing".
